Class Axis3D

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Item3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Line3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Axis3D
public class Axis3D extends Line3D
A single Cartesian axis: a Line3D from vmin to vmax along one of the Axis3D.AxisType directions, with major tick marks (added as Line3D children) and a lazily-created TextRenderer for the axis label and per-tick value labels.
